context_manifest.patch_state: uncommitted working tree changes prepared for independent EvidenceGate review

migrations: Moved standard-harness direct execution into a compatibility adapter that builds a one-node PlanIR and calls BoundedTaskExecutor.
Added NodeExecutor Protocol, NodeExecutionRequest, NodeExecutionResult, NodeExecutionStatus, and NodeExecutorRegistry.
Added NodeRun schema and example without changing released historical record schemas.
Added LocalRuntimeGateway.authorize_write_path for post-agent write authorization checks without performing writes.
Added effective_check_argv as a public helper so compatibility PlanIR command grants match actual deterministic check commands.

acceptance_map.criterion: bounded_task executes from a PlanNode and CapabilityGrant, not a bespoke WorkflowRunRequest path.
The executor cannot update Goal/Task completed state.
Deterministic checks are L0 Gates and semantic review is invoked only by declared Gate policy.
Rollback and terminal failure preserve patch, command and error Evidence.
Compatibility mode and native node mode produce equivalent observable Artifact/Evidence semantics.

verification.summary: 124 tests OK, 1 Windows symlink privilege skip

known_limitations: No DAG scheduler was implemented; this task only introduces the node executor primitive and compatibility adapter.
The standard-harness module id remains available as compatibility and should not be removed before TASK-0032.
The local runtime gateway remains a reference boundary for routed writes and commands, not a host-level sandbox.
The producer does not mark TASK-0028 completed; independent verifier and EvidenceGate decide completion.
